a1_settings.name: write_score_edit
a1_settings.use: T1's attributes-unit checks (check_attributes_unit), its row-record fields and checkpoints, and A1's own set (build_a1)

name: report_a1_variants

report.comparisons: optional other top-600 sets (L1, H1, the classifier, as each exists): a stage-1 selection record ('selected') or an engine edit file ('remove'), each named by SHA-256 on the command line
report.groups_guard_rule: per unit and checkpoint: the rows' mean cosine difference equals groups.json's harmful-minus-safe mean_cosine within checkpoint_cosine_tolerance; the rows' adam-difference sum equals groups.json's harmful-minus-safe adam_sum within checkpoint_adam_relative_tolerance times the sum of the absolute row terms and the absolute group value
report.jaccard: |A intersect B| / |A union B| of two top-600 sets
report.mean_identity_rule: (a^q + a^e1) / 2 equals T1's a_i for every row within the tolerance, or the report refuses
report.role: report only: never an arm and no edit file; the T1 A1 contract does not change
report.spearman: Spearman's rho = the Pearson correlation of average ranks (ties take the mean of their positions), over all training rows (stability) or over the 8 unit means (V1 against A1)
report.ties_rule: each variant's top 600 by s1common.select_top with its own part (the variant name): score descending, then the sealed rank over all training row ids

adam.name: V1, Adam-preconditioned: the mean over q and e1 of adam_H - adam_S (never called LESS)

requirement: W1-04 (W1 builder extract rev 2, 18b81b26; addendum section 5 item 2; Draft C R7.4): REQ-25, report only
